judged_text: app/models/embeddable_host.rb:17 — Comparison is asymmetric: stored host is lowercased in SQL but `uri.host` is not, so a host saved with uppercase letters (regex is `/i`) or an `embed_url`/referer with an uppercase hostname never matches; TopicEmbed.import passes a downcased URL while TopicRetriever/EmbedController pass raw input.
